fields.description: Choose your religion. If you are not religious, select OTHERS and complete the explanation.

records.caveat: Labels and guidance may be sample-based or provisional. Observed records contain directly checked choices and limits. Reported choices are separately sourced and have not been live verified. Unverified preparation options and validation rules are not exported. No complete live-form mapping is claimed.
